name: Find Cross-Domain Opportunity Pairs
jtbd: When I have a scoped research collection and want unexpected connections, rank pairs where semantic and structural signals disagree and give me their source links to investigate.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP server
requires: at least two artifacts with id, source_ref, and text
limitations: Signal disagreement identifies unusual pairs, not validated opportunities.
The user objective is included in review context but does not affect pair scoring.
Reference mode is based on source-analysis notes and has not been proven bit-for-bit equivalent to the original package.
Modern sentence-transformer mode is an experimental variant.
Model download is disabled by default; local execution does not itself enforce an OS sandbox.
The MCP server requires MindrianOS to validate room scope and research grant IDs; the IDs are audit references, not authorization on their own.
Human review ratings are recorded for evaluation and do not automatically change ranking behavior.
source_revision: independent implementation based on docs/engines/opportunity-pairs.md; original PPTX/package provenance pending
